title: Edmund and the Drop
author: Ines Reyes
blurb: Noor Sandoval, a whistle-blower living under four names, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
